meta.title: Mia's Wet Frog
meta.textType: story: a cartoon story with key words

paragraphs: On Tuesday after school, Lily and Mia practiced a puppet show in the garden. They had a green frog puppet and a yellow bird puppet. The show was for Teacher Kim's class on Friday. "Would you carry the bird, Mia?" asked Lily. "Yes, and I'll hold the frog, too," said Mia. Tom and Pip sat on the grass and watched them. Mia made the frog jump and sing. Lily moved the bird and said, "Hello, Frog!" Tom and Pip laughed and liked the show.

Then gray clouds came. The rain started. "Let's run into the house!" said Lily. Mia put the frog on the chair and ran. Pip saw the frog on the chair. He wanted to play. He took it in his mouth and ran into the rain. He fell on the wet grass, and the frog fell, too. "Pip, where are you?" shouted Mia. She found him by the tree. Pip put his head down, and he was sorry. The frog was very wet. Mia was sad.

"My frog is wet because of Pip!" said Mia. Tom ran out of the house with a big towel. "Don't worry, Mia," he said. "A towel can dry the frog." Lily and Mia dried the frog very well. Then the rain stopped, and the sun came out. When the frog was dry, Mia smiled. "I'm not angry, Pip," she said. "You wanted to play." On Friday, Pip sat by the table and watched the show. The frog was dry again, and the show was ready.
text.summary: Lily and Mia practice a puppet show in the garden. Pip takes the frog puppet into the rain, and Tom helps the girls dry it.
